subject: RStudio  autocompletion for Shiny input and output objects

messages.author: 276beb20b840713c
messages.subject: RStudio  autocompletion for Shiny input and output objects
parts:
Is there a way / trick to get RStudio to autocomplete on the shiny objects like input$foo or output$bar like the way it will autocomplete "regular" objects like fooobject$barcolumn?

I use RStudio a lot and as the size of the shiny application becomes larger this would help me during coding a lot to avoid silly typos etc. 

Any tips? Ideas?

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: RStudio  autocompletion for Shiny input and output objects
parts: If you develop your shiny app using the two-file structure (server.R and ui.R) as opposed to just using app.R, then newer versions of RStudio *should* autocomplete inputs and outputs
